title: Demiplanes
description: Datapack that add your own demiplane
body: This datapack adds new item that can teleport you (and any mobs in 2 block radius range) to your own demiplane (all players has their own demiplane) This demiplane look like a 48x48x48 hollow bedrock cube. Here you can build anything you want and items and building will be safe.   It is your safe base.
